# AxKit UI v2.0 · SEED Engine AI Rules & Guidelines

> AxKit is a SEED-based React UI component & design token system built on `@seed-design/css` and `@seed-design/react`.

## Quick Rules for AI Code Generation

1. **Imports**:
   - Always import UI components from `src/components/ui`:
     ```tsx
     import { ActionButton, Badge, TextField, TopNavigation } from '@/components/ui';
     ```
   - Always import monochrome icons from `@karrotmarket/react-monochrome-icon`:
     ```tsx
     import { IconMagnifyingglassLine, IconBellLine } from '@karrotmarket/react-monochrome-icon';
     ```

2. **Design Tokens**:
   - Use official 100% semantic CSS variables:
     - Foreground: `var(--seed-color-fg-neutral)`, `var(--seed-color-fg-brand)`, `var(--seed-color-fg-neutral-muted)`
     - Background: `var(--seed-color-bg-layer-default)`, `var(--seed-color-bg-layer-basement)`, `var(--seed-color-bg-brand-solid)`
     - Spacing: `var(--seed-dimension-x1)` to `x16` (4px steps: x1=4px, x2=8px, x3=12px, x4=16px)
     - Typography: `var(--seed-font-size-t1)` to `t14`

3. **Component Specs**:
   - `ActionButton`: `variant` = `"brandSolid"` | `"neutralWeak"` | `"neutralOutline"` | `"ghost"`, `size` = `"large"` | `"medium"` | `"small"` | `"xsmall"`
   - `TopNavigation`: `variant` = `"root"` | `"standard"`, `theme` = `"cupertino"` (iOS 44px) | `"android"` (56px)
   - `Badge`: `variant` = `"brandSolid"` | `"neutralWeak"` | `"positiveWeak"` | `"criticalWeak"`
   - Overlay Popups (`AlertDialog`, `BottomSheet`, `Dialog`, `SidePanel`): Always manage `open` and `onOpenChange` state.

4. **Repository**:
   - https://github.com/kimseoyun98/AxKit
